name: music_named_lines
description: Listening test: named lines, independent layers, mute — open Ctrl+M to watch
script: announce NAMED LINE TESTS — open Ctrl+M to watch the drawer
announce 1/8: Single named line — drums: c4(3,8)
announce 2/8: Two lines — drums + bass stacked
strudel c4(3,8) | c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ cps=0.8
announce 3/8: Three lines — drums + bass + melody
strudel c4(3,8) | c2 ~ e2 ~ | c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=0.5
announce 4/8: Different voices — flute melody + string chords + bass
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 | [c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] | c2 ~ c2 ~ s=bass cps=0.4
# === 5. Swap one line (melody changes, bass stays) ===
strudel [c5 b4 g4 e4]*2 | [c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] | c2 ~ c2 ~ s=bass cps=0.4
announce 6/8: Drop middle layer — melody + bass only
strudel [c5 b4 g4 e4]*2 | c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ s=bass cps=0.5
announce 7/8: Three euclidean layers at different rates
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the named lines work?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
